description: TaarYa benchmark suite v2 — 50 queries across 6 families with ground truth. All coordinates are J2000/ICRS. ground_truth fields use verifiable external evidence (Gaia DR3 catalogs, Kharchenko+ 2013, SIMBAD otype, WEBDA).

queries.prompt: Find all stars in a 3-degree cone centered on the Hyades core (RA=66.75°, Dec=15.87°).

ground_truth.expected_method: Q3C cone search on seeded region
ground_truth.verification: Compare against Kharchenko+ 2013 membership list for Hyades (tolerate field contamination)

queries.prompt: Find all stars within 1 degree of the Pleiades core (RA=56.75°, Dec=24.12°).

ground_truth.verification: Compare with Gaia Collaboration 2018 Pleiades membership catalogue

queries.prompt: Find all stars in the Orion OB1 association region (RA=83.82°, Dec=-5.39°, r=4°).

ground_truth.verification: Compare against SIMBAD OB association catalog entries for Orion OB1

queries.prompt: Find stars in the Coma Berenices open cluster region (RA=185°, Dec=25.83°, r=4°).

ground_truth.verification: Compare with Kharchenko+ 2013 Melotte 111 membership list

queries.prompt: Find stars in the Praesepe (M44) cluster region (RA=130.05°, Dec=19.52°, r=2.5°).

ground_truth.verification: Compare with WEBDA Praesepe membership catalog

queries.prompt: Find stars in NGC 2516 (RA=119.71°, Dec=-60.85°, r=0.5°).

ground_truth.verification: Kharchenko+ 2013 NGC 2516 membership list

queries.prompt: Find stars in the Alpha Persei (M34) region (RA=51.08°, Dec=49.86°, r=2°).

ground_truth.verification: WEBDA Alpha Persei membership catalog
Kharchenko+ 2013 IC 2391 membership list

queries.prompt: Find all stars in a 10-degree cone around the Galactic anti-center (RA=90°, Dec=0°).

ground_truth.verification: Should return thousands in this direction; cap at limit=500 is intentional

queries.prompt: Find stars in a 0.1-degree cone at RA=0°, Dec=+90° (celestial north pole).

ground_truth.verification: Dense region but small radius should return few results; tests empty-sky handling

queries.prompt: Find stars within 2 degrees of the Galactic plane at l=60°, b=0° (RA≈105°, Dec≈0°).

ground_truth.verification: Galactic plane has high stellar density; should saturate limit

queries.prompt: Find candidates in the Hyades region (RA=66.75°, Dec=15.87°, r=5°) with proper motion above 80 mas/yr.

ground_truth.verification: Confirmed hypervelocity or high-tangential-velocity stars in this region require SIMBAD validation; internal threshold check only

queries.task: High proper motion — Coma Ber region
queries.prompt: Find high-proper-motion stars in the Coma Berenices region (RA=185°, Dec=25.83°, r=4°) above 60 mas/yr.

ground_truth.verification: Coma Ber is a moving group; some members have elevated proper motion vs. field

queries.prompt: Find blue outliers (BP-RP < -0.1) in the Pleiades region (RA=56.75°, Dec=24.12°, r=2°).

ground_truth.verification: Blue objects in Pleiades: blue stragglers, hot subdwarfs; verify with SIMBAD otype

queries.prompt: Find very red stars (BP-RP > 2.8) in Orion OB1 region (RA=83.82°, Dec=-5.39°, r=4°).

ground_truth.verification: M-type dwarfs and giants expected in this direction

queries.prompt: Find anomalously bright stars (G < 10) at distances > 500 pc in the Praesepe region.

ground_truth.verification: Very bright stars at Praesepe distance are giants; few if any in Gaia DR3 bright limit

queries.prompt: Find stars with RUWE > 2.0 in the NGC 2516 region indicating possible binarity.

ground_truth.verification: Open clusters have elevated binary fraction; RUWE > 2.0 suggests unresolved multiplicity

queries.prompt: Find isolated stars (fewer than 3 neighbors within 1 deg) in the Alpha Persei region.

ground_truth.verification: Field star contaminants outside cluster radius

queries.prompt: Find stars in Orion OB1 that are simultaneously high-motion (mu > 40 mas/yr) AND blue (BP-RP < 0.5).

ground_truth.expected_method: Discovery ranking + combined motion + color filter
ground_truth.verification: Young massive stars in Orion OB1 have high motion and hot colors

queries.prompt: Find papers discussing the age and formation history of the Pleiades open cluster.

params.query: Pleiades age formation history open cluster

ground_truth.expected_method: Qdrant vector similarity on paper abstracts
ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; relevance judged by cosine similarity score >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on the internal dynamics and mass segregation in the Hyades cluster.

params.query: Hyades cluster internal dynamics mass segregation

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers discussing star formation in the Orion OB1 association.

params.query: Orion OB1 association star formation massive stars

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on the structure of the Milky Way Galaxy based on Gaia DR3 data.

params.query: Milky Way structure Gaia DR3 disk kinematics

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on photometric variability and variable stars in open clusters.

params.query: variable stars open clusters photometric variability

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.task: Literature search — White dwarfs in clusters
queries.prompt: Find papers on white dwarf cooling and age-dating of open clusters using white dwarfs.

params.query: white dwarf cooling open cluster age dating

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on binary star dynamics and N-body simulations in star clusters.

params.query: binary star dynamics N-body simulations star clusters

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on hypervelocity stars and their origin in the Galactic halo.

params.query: hypervelocity stars Galactic halo origin Brown 2015

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 3; cosine similarity >= 0.7; specific mention of Brown+ 2015

queries.prompt: Find papers on astrometric exoplanet detection using Gaia DR3 data.

params.query: Gaia DR3 astrometric exoplanet detection orbital solutions

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on metallicity gradients across open clusters in the Milky Way.

params.query: open clusters metallicity gradient Milky Way galactic disk

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers on Hertzsprung-Russell diagram analysis for stellar population studies.

params.query: Hertzsprung Russell diagram stellar populations isochrone fitting

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 5; cosine similarity >= 0.7

queries.prompt: Find papers authored by or citing work by Jeremy R. King on star cluster membership.

params.query: Jeremy King star cluster membership Gaia

ground_truth.verification: Return count >= 2; author field contains 'King'

queries.prompt: Find and rank the most interesting stars in the Hyades region (RA=66.75°, Dec=15.87°, r=5°) combining catalog data and literature.

ground_truth.verification: Top candidates should include: highest motion stars, highest RUWE, bluest/reddest colors; graph should return papers on Hyades membership and dynamics

queries.prompt: Find and rank candidates in the Coma Berenices region combining spatial search, discovery ranking, and literature.

ground_truth.verification: Candidates should include high-proper-motion members, color outliers; papers should include Kharchenko+ membership studies

queries.prompt: Find all relevant stars in Praesepe and return them with discovery scores, literature context, and HR diagram data.

ground_truth.verification: HR diagram should show main sequence + giant branch; discovery scores should flag giants, binaries

queries.prompt: Find high-confidence anomalies in NGC 2516 using the strict discovery profile.

ground_truth.verification: Strict profile should return only the highest-confidence candidates (RUWE > 2.0 or motion > 80 mas/yr)

queries.prompt: Find low-mass M-dwarf candidates in Alpha Persei (G > 12, BP-RP > 1.4) that may be cluster members.

ground_truth.verification: Alpha Persei has known M-dwarf members; compare with WEBDA membership

queries.prompt: Find binary candidates in Orion OB1 with RUWE > 1.4 AND photometric parallax consistency.

ground_truth.verification: Orion OB1 is young; high RUWE indicates youth + binarity; compare with ElBadry+ 2021 binary catalog

queries.prompt: Find giant branch stars in the Hyades region (M_G < 4, BP-RP > 0.5) for HR diagram anchor points.

ground_truth.expected_method: Discovery ranking + absolute magnitude + color filter
ground_truth.verification: Hyades has known giant branch members; compare with Gaia DR3 HR diagram locus

queries.prompt: Find papers discussing the calibration and accuracy of Gaia DR3 astrometric solutions.

params.query: Gaia DR3 astrometric calibration accuracy Lindegren 2021

ground_truth.verification: Should return Lindegren+ 2021 and related Gaia DPAC papers

queries.prompt: Find papers using MESA (Modules for Experiments in Stellar Astrophysics) for stellar evolution modeling.

params.query: MESA Paxton 2011 stellar evolution code inlist

ground_truth.verification: Should return Paxton+ 2011, 2013, 2015 MESA series papers

queries.prompt: Retrieve all stars within 1 degree of the boundary between the Hyades and Praesepe clusters (approximately RA=98°, Dec=17.5°).

ground_truth.verification: Tests whether the spatial search correctly handles a direction between two cluster centers

queries.prompt: Find stars in a 0.5-degree cone around Sirius (RA=101.29°, Dec=-16.72°) for wide binary companion search.

ground_truth.verification: Field around Sirius should include Sirius A + known companions and field stars

queries.prompt: Find stars in a 0.2-degree cone at Galactic anticenter (l=180°, b=0°, RA≈315°, Dec≈0°).

ground_truth.verification: Tests handling of sparse anticenter direction

queries.prompt: Find stars in the Hyades region with parallax inconsistent with cluster distance (within 5 deg of Hyades center but parallax > 25 mas or < 18 mas).

ground_truth.verification: Hyades distance ~22.5 mas (44.5 pc); foreground/background contamination expected

queries.prompt: Find very young star candidates (blue + high motion + high RUWE) in IC 2391 consistent with ~50 Myr age.

ground_truth.verification: IC 2391 is ~50 Myr; should contain few Herbig Ae/Be and T Tauri stars

queries.prompt: Find papers on the Gaia hyperspatial resolution method for detecting binary stars.

params.query: Gaia hyperspatial resolution binary star detection astrometric excess noise

ground_truth.verification: Should return Gaia Collaboration papers on hyperspatial analysis

queries.prompt: Find papers on cross-identification between Gaia DR3 and other major catalogs (SIMBAD, VizieR, LAMOST).

params.query: Gaia DR3 cross-match SIMBAD VizieR catalog identification

ground_truth.verification: Should return papers on cross-identification methodology

queries.prompt: Use the strict discovery profile to find the highest-confidence anomaly candidates in Orion OB1.

ground_truth.verification: Strict should flag: RUWE > 2.0, motion > 80 mas/yr, or blue + high motion combined

queries.prompt: Use the aggressive discovery profile to maximize recall of any unusual star in Alpha Persei.

ground_truth.verification: Aggressive should return all stars with any signal flag; confirm variety of signal types

queries.prompt: Retrieve 20 candidates from Praesepe with full provenance metadata, HR diagram, and DS9 region export.

ground_truth.expected_method: HybridSearch + HR diagram + DS9 export + provenance
ground_truth.verification: VOTable must be valid VOTable 1.4; provenance manifest must include session_id, timestamp, query params
